svg.title: Synthetic coastal extent definitions
svg.desc: Two synthetic scalar profiles, not ocean measurements. The first has a missing inshore velocity region: one-sided, supported-domain and conditional shore-referenced extents differ. The second has two velocity crossings and a disconnected inshore support reference. Text below each panel gives the bounds and unresolved outcomes.
svg.text: Boundary choice changes the reported quantity
Constructed profiles only · 5 km sampling · 2 km native-scale fixture · no measurement admission
A · Core reaches the inshore support limit
Projected velocity q (m/s); signed normal distance s (km).
Shore extent is conditional: the 5–10 km inshore model gap remains unsupported.
Projected velocity q (m/s); signed normal distance s (km).
The inshore support reference lies outside the connected half-peak core.
Hatching: missing velocities · outlined band: support transition · amber bands: threshold brackets
Bands mark sampling/reference brackets. They are not physical uncertainty or annual ranges.
